status: Historical review-stage evidence; owner accepted November 11; superseded by 2026-11-11-older-tabs-adoption.json
requirements: Stable calendar heading views animate with tab rows; headings are not drag sources
Individual Older tab can return to its frozen chronological slot or move into regular tabs; arbitrary Older reordering is rejected
Older Tabs has no count or leading icon; semibold system section typography at the same font size as tab labels
Trailing native chevron.down/chevron.forward only on hover; horizontal center matches tab close icon
Two thirds of a blank tab-row slot above section; 18px section content, 24px hit target extending upward, and 16px date headers share bottom clearance
No Today/Yesterday heading; weekday headings for days 2-7; final Older bucket beyond 7 calendar days
Smaller uppercase date labels aligned with section title, AppKit semantic secondary label color; date rows trim 2px at top and bottom
No additional inset in tab content; full-width rows
Move choices Never, 6 hours, 1 day, 2 days; close choices Immediately, 1 day, 2 days, 3 days, 7 days, Never
Immediately closes eligible aged regular tabs directly without entering Older; protections and launch/settings grace preserved
Move inactive tabs from groups defaults off; Never collapses both dependent settings
Group cleanup waits for saved-group initialization and pending restoration connections
Finder section weight/color: semibold system font matching tab-label metrics and native secondary label color
Header context menu: Close All Older Tabs, Keep All Older Tabs, Settings
Keep Tab available in both Command-T and Command-/ only for the active Older tab; availability revalidated before dispatch
Grouped-tab description exactly: Allow moving inactive tabs from tab groups to Older Tabs
Chevron lifted 3px to center against Older Tabs text
Date heading removes preceding Older tab row trailing 2px gap; following-tab clearance unchanged
Older tab menu omits creation, Add/Move, Pin, Close Other Tabs and Close Tabs Above; regular menu retains them
Pinned tabs never age; stale Older state on restored pinned tabs is cleared
Only Continue where you left off automatically restores Older Tabs across a clean quit; New Tab and specified-page startup modes do not
No redundant Organize inactive tabs UI or enable preference; Never suspends cleanup and presents every tab without Older section/date headings
Date labels use a further 15 percent alpha reduction and their glyphs sit 1px higher inside the unchanged layout box
Chevron uses the tab close icon 11pt medium / 16px canvas recipe and hovered tab foreground color; additional 2px adjustment removed
Default close retention is 3 days (72 hours), preserving the 7-day option
